views.name: spend
views.what: the team's spend by day, in total

notes: 1 day had fewer than 3 people working and is shown only in the total.

views.name: models
views.what: the team's spend by model; a model used by fewer people than the team's minimum group is folded into one line

notes: 1 model had fewer than 3 people using it and is folded into one line, so that no line is one person's own figure.
The lines are in alphabetical order, not in order of cost.

views.name: projects
views.what: the team's spend by project; a project worked on by fewer people than the minimum group is folded into one line

notes: 3 projects had fewer than 3 people using them and are folded into one line, so that no line is one person's own figure.
The lines are in alphabetical order, not in order of cost.

views.name: landing
views.what: what the team's spend bought: the share of it that landed, in total

notes: Landed means merged or kept. The share is of the spend whose outcome the ledgers know; spend with no outcome recorded is shown apart and is in no share.
This is the team in total; it is not cut by person.

views.name: me
views.what: your own spend by day, from your own reports
views.reason: 'me' needs the role member or higher; you are a viewer

views.name: people
views.what: spend by person, listed by name and never ranked
views.reason: 'people' needs the role lead or higher; you are a viewer

views.name: roles
views.what: who is in the team and the role each holds
views.reason: 'roles' needs the role lead or higher; you are a viewer

views.name: access-log
views.what: every request to see something, who made it, and whether it was allowed
views.reason: 'access-log' needs the role owner; you are a viewer

views.name: settings
views.what: the team's settings: per-person views and the minimum group
views.reason: 'settings' needs the role owner; you are a viewer
